snapshot.title: Second Remote ID Feed — Drone Over West Grandstand

lines.msg: New Remote ID feed received: aircraft 'RID-BM-12-004' confirmed in flight over Harwick Fairgrounds.
Track stability: 98.7% confidence; no replay detected.
Altitude: 320 ft AGL; pattern: circular, 500 m radius, centered on west grandstand.
Broadcast mode: standard (FOM-10.1); no anomalies in payload or telemetry.
Serial 'RID-BM-12-004' not in Group fleet register (FOM-101) or GCS-01 Remote ID cache.
Second confirmed feed from same aircraft (crs: 312.01234567); pattern unchanged from first report (11:03).
Persistent unknown drone over public event (6,000 attendees); HUOG-ERP Section 8.4 triggered.
Harwick Police Command notified via encrypted channel (FIR-2026-1025-1205).
Flight status: no Group aircraft airborne (FOM-102). All fleet confirmed grounded.

snapshot.instructorNote: Confirm the drone's persistence and update the hazard log. The technical team must not assume the feed is fake or corrupted; the alert is valid and triggers HUOG-ERP Section 8.4.
